run_object_detection_on_images: run object detection on input images using a Detectron2 config and save visualized outputs
run_object_detection_on_webcam: run real-time object detection on webcam feed using Detectron2 with OpenCV display
run_object_detection_on_video: run object detection on a video file and optionally save the annotated output video
setup_detectron2_config: setup a Detectron2 configuration from a YAML file with command-line overrides and confidence threshold
test_opencv_video_codec: test whether a given OpenCV video codec and file extension are supported on the current system
